name: Tablet PC Pen Training
description: Windows MDM settings in the Tablet PC Pen Training category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Turn off Tablet PC Pen Training
properties.description:
Turns off Tablet PC Pen Training.

If you enable this policy setting, users cannot open Tablet PC Pen Training.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, users can open Tablet PC Pen Training.

properties.name: Turn off Tablet PC Pen Training (User)
properties.description:
Turns off Tablet PC Pen Training.

If you enable this policy setting, users cannot open Tablet PC Pen Training.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, users can open Tablet PC Pen Training.
